# Generating twice gives the same files: route_paths.go and each package's
# template_routes.go are byte-identical after a second muxt generate.

muxt generate
exists route_paths.go
cp route_paths.go first_route_paths.go.txt
cp admin/template_routes.go first_admin_routes.go.txt
cp blog/template_routes.go first_blog_routes.go.txt

muxt generate
cmp route_paths.go first_route_paths.go.txt
cmp admin/template_routes.go first_admin_routes.go.txt
cmp blog/template_routes.go first_blog_routes.go.txt
exec go build ./...

-- go.mod --
module example.com/m

go 1.22
-- muxt.json --
{
  "route_paths": {},
  "package_defaults": {
    "use_receiver_type": "Server"
  },
  "packages": {
    "example.com/m/admin": [
      {}
    ],
    "example.com/m/blog": [
      {}
    ]
  }
}
-- admin/admin.go --
package admin

import "html/template"

var templates = template.Must(template.New("GET /admin Dashboard()").Parse(`<a href="{{$.Path.Blog.GetArticle 42}}">article</a>`))

type Server struct{}

func (Server) Dashboard() string { return "dashboard" }
-- blog/blog.go --
package blog

import "html/template"

var templates = template.Must(template.New("GET /article/{id} GetArticle(id)").Parse(`<h1>{{.Result}}</h1><a href="{{.Path.Admin.Dashboard}}">admin</a>`))

type Server struct{}

func (Server) GetArticle(id int) string { return "article" }
